text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: production /v1/generate p95 latency >= 2.5s for 6m — paging oncall
alex (oncall): taking this. jumping into traces and dashboard now.
jess: saw queue depth spike on gpu-node-07 in us-west-2 around 12:02. batching backlog probable.
maria: any customer errors reported?
luis (support): 4 tickets from BetaCorp 12:04-12:08 with timeouts, marking as high priority but no data leak.
alex (oncall): evicting gpu-node-07 from the pool and draining connections.
alex (oncall): running: `rdctl node drain --name gpu-node-07 --reason 'suspected long-batch backlog'`
deploy-bot: drain job queued (id: drain-2026-03-15-07)
jess: p95 dropped slightly after drain but still above SLO. another hotspot on gpu-node-02.
maria: tracing shows many long-context requests with KV-cache misses — likely from a scheduled analytics job hitting the long-context model.
sam (ml-eng): confirmed a scheduled batch run misconfigured and sending long sequences to the unquantized variant.
alex (oncall): apply temporary routing: route non-enterprise traffic to long-context-quantized to relieve native servers.
alex (oncall): `routing apply --when 'model==long-context && tier!=enterprise' --to long-context-quantized --ttl 2h`
incident-bot: routing change applied by alex (oncall)
luis (support): informing BetaCorp about temporary fallback and asking them to retry.
jess: scaling infer-pool up to reduce queueing (replica bump).
jess: `kubectl scale deployment/infer-pool --replicas=16`
deploy-bot: scale event started (infer-pool -> 16)
alex (oncall): alert (p95 > 2.5s for 6m) is noisy during mitigations. proposing temporary silence and threshold adjustment while we observe routing + scale effects.
sam (ml-eng): agree. propose temporary alert change: p95(route:/v1/generate) -> 3.2s and evaluate over 10m for non-enterprise while enterprise stays stricter. will file a follow-up ticket.
alex (oncall): creating silence for the alert for 75 minutes.
alex (oncall): `alerts silence create --id alert-9876 --duration 75m --reason 'evict+route+scale in progress'`
incident-bot: silence created (alert-9876) by alex
jess: autoscaler also spun an extra node; keeping it online for now.
deploy-bot: scale event completed (infer-pool -> 16)
sam (ml-eng): running quick synthetic replay to validate quantized variant latency.
sam (ml-eng): `./replay --profile long-context --qps 40 --duration 8m`
sam (ml-eng): results: quantized p95 ~1.1s, native p95 ~2.9s under current load.
maria: adding KV cache prefetch experiment to canary to reduce miss penalty.
alex (oncall): handoff in 20m to @sam. summary for handoff: root cause — mis-scheduled long-context batch job hitting unquantized variant causing KV misses and queue buildup. mitigations — drain problem node, route non-enterprise to quantized variant, scale pool, create alert silence; customer impact — BetaCorp had transient timeouts, retries succeeded. follow-ups — ticket INF-5510 for thresholds, INF-5511 for dashboard, CHG-802 for batch limiter change.
sam (ml-eng): taking over. kicking off longer replay and creating a dashboard panel for kv-miss-rate vs p95 by variant. panel id dash-10421.
sam (ml-eng): opening INF-5510: suggested alert rules: enterprise p95(route:/v1/generate) > 2.0s for 10m -> page; non-enterprise: warning at 3.0s for 10m, paging only at 3.8s for 20m.
maria: adding an alert for KV miss rate > 4% (warning) so we can get early signal for long-context regressions.
jess: change ticket CHG-802 created to reduce max_seq_batch in infer-proxy: `max_seq_batch: 48 -> 24` with canary.
deploy-bot: change CHG-802 scheduled for canary 2026-03-15T20:30Z
luis (support): BetaCorp updated: service restored for most requests, we advise retrying failed calls. will keep monitoring tickets.
sam (ml-eng): promoting routing TTL to 6h while we roll out batch limiter change.
alex (oncall): creating maintenance window for tonight's batch-limiter rollout.
alex (oncall): `maintenance create --scope infer-pool --start '2026-03-15T20:00Z' --duration 4h --notes 'batch-limiter rollout and canary'`
incident-bot: maintenance mw-410 created by alex
maria: will run KV prefetch canary then promote. will post results to postmortem doc.
sam (ml-eng): follow-up tasks created: INF-5510 (alerts thresholds), INF-5511 (dashboard dash-10421), INF-5512 (batch limiter rollback plan).
alex (oncall): note for cleanup: remove silence for alert-9876 after thresholds validated; add permanent dashboard panels and update runbook sections about long-context scheduling.
sam (ml-eng): post-change canary looks stable. scheduling final validation run after full rollout. tagging @maria for KV tuning verification.
luis (support): BetaCorp acknowledged and is satisfied with interim fixes. :thumbsup:
alex (oncall): closing realtime thread. I'll draft postmortem and link these tasks.
incident-bot: Pager resolved: alert-9876 not firing for 30m
sam (ml-eng): thanks all — will post postmortem draft to #postmortems and request reviews.
